title: Traffic Sculptor smoke harness for p95 shift detection
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a lightweight CI smoke harness (Traffic Sculptor) that sculpts short, deterministic traffic shapes to surface regressions in tokens/sec and p95 latency. The harness should be suitable to run on every PR (fast, low GPU/time cost) and produce a compact baseline artifact that downstream gates can compare against. Focus goals: 1) surface regressive changes that matter to production cost/latency (tokens/sec drop, p95 uplift), 2) keep CI runtime < 6 minutes and GPU cost minimal, 3) provide actionable signal (delta + attribution to workload shape). This ticket covers design, minimal implementation, CI integration, and docs for on-call usage.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible smoke workload builder that emits at least three traffic shapes (steady, microburst, long-tail) with parameterized seq lengths and prompt prefixes
Baseline artifact format defined (JSON) with median tokens/sec, p95 latency, 5/50/95 quantiles, and workload shape metadata
CI step added that runs the harness under a small reserved GPU, compares new run to baseline using rolling-quantile test, and fails PR if posterior probability of latency regression > 95%
End-to-end run completes within 6 minutes on the CI GPU pool (configurable timeout), and cost noise measured in <5% in repeated runs
Ops doc and quick triage checklist added to Confluence with links to artifact and PR rerun commands
work_log: 2026-02-24 - Asha: Initial spec drafted after 1:1 with Perf PM. Chosen metaphor: 'Traffic Sculptor' to emphasize shape-based probing rather than single-shot throughput.

2026-02-27 - Marco: Spike implemented prototype harness that emits steady + burst shapes. Measured baseline median tokens/sec and p95 on local rig; results show stable p95 variance ~3% across 10 runs.
2026-03-03 - Marco: Integrated deterministic seed and KV-cache primer to reduce cold-start noise. Observed p95 noise drop from 7% -> 3.2% on synthetic model-quantized variant.

2026-03-06 - Asha: Reviewed trade-offs in design doc: (1) short smoke runs miss long-run memory leaks, (2) CI cost vs signal trade; agreed to keep harness focused on regression gating and run extended nightly replicas separately.
2026-03-10 - Marco: Implemented rolling-quantile comparator using Bayesian bootstrap; added threshold parameter (default confidence=0.95). Hooked comparator into CI step wrapper script.

2026-03-12 - Asha: Wrote initial Confluence doc (Traffic Sculptor runbook) and added triage checklist. Preparing PR to add CI job and baseline artifacts; marking ticket for in-review testing on staging CI node.
test_strategy: Run harness three times in CI per PR and aggregate with Bayesian bootstrap to estimate posterior for p95 delta
Use deterministic seeds and KV-cache primer to reduce non-determinism; allow opt-out for nightlies to test cold-starts
If PR fails gate, automatically store detailed artifact and trigger optional rerun job that executes extended 4-run smoke to confirm before human triage
risks_and_mitigations: False positives due to transient infra noise - mitigation: deterministic seed + primer + repeat-run confirmation before human pages
High cost when run on every PR - mitigation: keep run short (<6m), use a small reserved GPU class and fall back to lightweight CPU simulation for trivial changes
Signal blind spots for very long-tail regressions - mitigation: pair with nightly extended suites (separate ticket) and make Traffic Sculptor gate conservative for long-tail-only shifts
decisions: Decision: Use rolling-quantile Bayesian comparator instead of simple t-test because latency distributions are heavy-tailed and non-Gaussian
Decision: Store compact baseline artifacts in S3 keyed by model+quantization+seqprofile to allow per-job comparisons
Decision: Fail-fast CI on high-confidence p95 regressions but run automatic confirmation rerun before opening an incident ticket
next_steps: Merge runtime PR and CI job, then run 48-hour canary on staging CI node to measure flakiness
Add dashboard tile in Console for Traffic Sculptor baseline drift (tokens/sec and p95 over time) - dashboard request to Product Dashboard team
Create follow-up ticket to add nightly extended probes for memory/throughput degradation detection
